items.label: 100FT String Lights for Outside
items.value: BYGUQ 30 meter outdoor patios lights is perfect for covering expansive areas like patio, gazebos. The same model can be connected up to 200 feet, great for outdoor hanging lights, deck lights, and fence lighting.

items.label: Remote Control & Dimmable Brightness
items.value: Easily adjust your outdoor lighting with the remote. Choose from 3 lightning modes and 4 brightness for any occasion, from cozy evenings to lively backyard parties. These dimmable string lights for outside offer ultimate convenience and ambiance control.

items.label: Weatherproof & Shatterproof Design
items.value: Outdoor led lights with IP65 waterproof rating and durable PET shatterproof bulbs, these tree lights withstand rain, wind, snow, and extreme temperatures. Safe for families and pets, ideal for porch lights outdoor, garden lights, and backyard lights outdoor.

items.label: Energy Saving & Easy Installation
items.value: Each bulb operates independently, so a failure in one bulb will not affect the others. Built-in hooks for quick hanging. (If the bulb does not light, try tightening it 1-2 more turns to ensure good contact.)

items.label: Timer & Multiple Lighting Modes
items.value: Set your preferred auto-off timer(3/5H) and forget about manually turning off the lights. Switch between steady, breathing, and flash modes to match the vibe of gatherings, dinners, or festive celebrations, Ideal for year-round decoration.
